<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\Principals;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> PrincipalsSyncedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$applicationCode</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$created</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$deactivated</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$syncedEmails</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$updated</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            applicationCode: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'applicationCode'</span>],
            created: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'created'</span>],
            deactivated: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'deactivated'</span>],
            syncedEmails: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'syncedEmails'</span>],
            updated: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'updated'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'applicationCode'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;applicationCode,
            <span class="hl-str">'created'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;created,
            <span class="hl-str">'deactivated'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;deactivated,
            <span class="hl-str">'syncedEmails'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;syncedEmails,
            <span class="hl-str">'updated'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;updated,
        ];
    }
}
